thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike observed for tenant 'summitcorp' in us-west1 dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-42). SLO breach threshold crossed at 1982345676. Auto-scaling attempted 3x, partially successful.
Alice Kim: acked. I'm oncall. tagging eng-sre.
Ben Ortiz: looking. metrics show p95 -> 820ms (baseline 120ms), p99 -> 2.3s. error rate stable, so it's latency not errors.
Carla Nguyen: pinging SummitCorp AM and their SRE to notify of degradation. Carla -> summitcorp-support@summitcorp.com (copied).
Dmitri Petrov: checking pool health and GPU utilization. initial glance: GPUs ~90-98% on some nodes, KV cache growth unusually high for a subset of tenants.
Alice Kim: can we isolate tenant traffic? Is summitcorp on a dedicated slice or shared within dp-42?
Dmitri Petrov: they have reserved tenants on slice-7 of dp-42 but serving path routes through shared frontends. basket of pods shows 6/12 pods saturated by long-lived sessions.
Ben Ortiz: suspect long contexts + large batched streaming requests causing KV thrash. pulling recent request traces now.
incident-bot: Trace summary (top 5 slow queries):
```
- req 1: session id xxxxx latency 2.8s context len 16k tokens batch 1
- req 2: session id yyyyy latency 2.4s context len 18k tokens batch 2
- req 3: session id zzzzz latency 2.1s context len 12k tokens batch 1
```
Alice Kim: ok action plan: 1) short term: enable emergency tenant isolation routing for summitcorp (move to isolated frontends + throttled concurrency) 2) scale up slice-7 with warm nodes (if capacity) 3) apply KV cache eviction tweak to reduce memory churn 4) notify customer and provide ETA.
Carla Nguyen: SummitCorp SRE is available. They've confirmed high-volume long-running sessions from a nightly job. They asked us to avoid immediate token loss.
Ben Ortiz: I'll roll a routing rule: route summitcorp -> isolated frontends in us-west1. That should cut cross-tenant interference. Doing canary now.
Dmitri Petrov: provisioning warm nodes, +4 GPUs to slice-7. ETA ~6m. Starting now.
Alice Kim: Ben, when you flip routing, also temporarily cap per-connection in-flight tokens to 4096 to protect the KV cache. Put aggressive backpressure headers so client sees 429s early rather than p99 spikes.
Ben Ortiz: deploying routing change and per-connection cap. snippet: `route set --tenant summitcorp --target isolated-frontends --concurrency-cap 4096`. rolling to 3 hosts for canary.
Ben Ortiz: canary looks good on two hosts; p95 dropped to ~180ms for canary traffic.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: routing-policy-update succeeded for 3/3 canary hosts.
Alice Kim: good. Dmitri, how are the new nodes?
Dmitri Petrov: warm nodes ready; attaching to slice-7 now. watching CPU/GPU and mem.
Dmitri Petrov: after attach, node utilization spread out, previously hot nodes down to 55-70%.
Ben Ortiz: observed overall p95 across summitcorp down to 240ms, p99 ~560ms. still above baseline but much better.
Carla Nguyen: letting SummitCorp know we're moving traffic and adding capacity. telling them we'll avoid killing sessions.
Emily Stone: customer success note: SummitCorp says their nightly job is ramping earlier than expected today due to a staging sync. They're going to throttle their job from their side too—coordinating a rolling backoff.
Alice Kim: plan for next hour: keep tenant isolated, keep capacity +4 GPUs, monitor for 30m. If p99 < 700ms and no other regressions, we'll gradually reduce per-connection cap to 8192 and move back to normal frontends overnight.
Ben Ortiz: adding an alert to track KV eviction rate and context length distribution for summitcorp.
Dmitri Petrov: left a note to ops to run a KV cache eviction config: `kv.eviction.window_ms=1000` to reduce thrash. will roll to canary after 10m.
Alice Kim: handoff: I'm going to start a 30m watch. After that, Ben will take second shift if things stable. Ben, you ready to take oncall in 30?
Ben Ortiz: ready. I'll take over at 1982345902. leaving playbook steps in the incident doc.
Carla Nguyen: will draft customer postmortem note and SLA impact assessment. likely partial SLO breach of p99 for 00:12 duration.
Emily Stone: coordinating follow-up with SummitCorp PM for scheduling a long-term rate limit and ingestion window to avoid nightly sync overlap with peak traffic.
Alice Kim: any blockers?
Ben Ortiz: none. metrics look healthy for isolated traffic. continuing to watch.
incident-bot: REMINDER: oncall rotation change in 30m for Alice -> Ben.
Alice Kim: closing room for now; we'll keep thread pinned and escalate if p99 > 1.2s. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: acknowledged. continuing watch.
Carla Nguyen: thanks team. I'll update the customer-facing channel with a summary in 10m.
Dmitri Petrov: will follow-up with a config PR for KV tuning and a capacity recommendation for slice-7.
Emily Stone: filing a quick action item: "SummitCorp: schedule sync window + guardrails" assigned to Carla.
Alice Kim: end of thread for now.
